title: frasera bimaculata
intro: Frasera bimaculata, commonly known as the two-spotted columbine, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Frasera bimaculata include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its use as a diuretic to help with urinary tract issues. The bioactive constituents of Frasera bimaculata include iridoids and xanthones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
